casuta-brazi.name: Fir Tree Cabin
casuta-brazi.description: Wooden cabin at the edge of the forest, with a fireplace, terrace and views of Piatra Craiului. Ideal for families or friends looking for peace and quiet.

camera-balcon.name: Double Room with Balcony
camera-balcon.description: Bright room with a double bed and a balcony facing the mountains. Breakfast with local produce is included.

apartament-panoramic.name: Panoramic Apartment
apartament-panoramic.description: Two-bedroom apartment with an open-plan living room and large windows overlooking the valley. Fully equipped kitchen.

garsoniera-cires.name: Cherry Tree Studio
garsoniera-cires.description: Modern, compact studio with a kitchenette and a workspace. Suited to couples or short trips.

camera-familie.name: Family Room
camera-familie.description: Spacious room with a double bed and a sofa bed. Children under 6 stay free.

casuta-rosie.name: Little Red Cabin
casuta-rosie.description: Secluded cabin on a hill, with its own garden and barbecue. Dirt road for the last 300 m.

apartament-lac.name: Lakeside Apartment
apartament-lac.description: Large apartment with two bathrooms and a living room with a sofa bed. A 5-minute walk to the lake.

camera-mansarda.name: Attic Room
camera-mansarda.description: Cosy room under the roof, with wooden beams and a window facing the forest.

garsoniera-brad.name: Fir Studio
garsoniera-brad.description: New studio in a wood-and-glass house, with a private terrace and forest views.

olimp-panorama.name: Sea Panorama Apartment
olimp-panorama.description: 6th-floor apartment with a large terrace and a direct sea view. 2 minutes from the beach.

olimp-studio.name: Seafront Studio
olimp-studio.description: Bright studio right on the promenade, with a balcony facing the sunrise.

neptun-pescarusul.name: Seagull Cottage
neptun-pescarusul.description: House with a private pool and garden, 300 m from the beach. Ideal for two families.

neptun-lac.name: Lake Neptun Apartment
neptun-lac.description: Quiet apartment overlooking Lake Neptun and the Comorova forest.

neptun-park.name: Neptun Park Double Room
neptun-park.description: Room in a complex with a pool, breakfast included.

jupiter-balcon.name: Jupiter Room with Balcony
jupiter-balcon.description: Simple, clean room close to the resort centre.

capaurora-garsoniera.name: Cap Aurora Studio
capaurora-garsoniera.description: Renovated studio with a kitchenette and a balcony with a side sea view.

capaurora-lumina.name: Villa Lumina
capaurora-lumina.description: Four-bedroom villa with a heated pool and a rooftop terrace.

venus-garden.name: Venus Garden Room
venus-garden.description: Room in a guesthouse with a garden, 5 minutes from the beach.

venus-mirage.name: Mirage Studio
venus-mirage.description: Modern studio with a kitchen, in a quiet area.

venus-ana.name: Ana Apartment
venus-ana.description: Pet-friendly apartment with a shared yard and a parking space.

saturn-familie.name: Saturn Family Room
saturn-familie.description: Large family room in a hotel with a children's pool.

saturn-delfinul.name: Dolphin Apartment
saturn-delfinul.description: Sea-view apartment, a few steps from the beach.

saturn-dune.name: Cabin by the Dunes
saturn-dune.description: Wooden cabin with a gazebo and barbecue, right next to the sand dunes.

mangalia-port.name: Mangalia Harbour Apartment
mangalia-port.description: Apartment overlooking the marina and the promenade.

mangalia-callatis.name: Callatis Room
mangalia-callatis.description: Room in the old town, next to the Callatis archaeological site.

mangalia-faleza.name: North Promenade Studio
mangalia-faleza.description: Studio on the North Promenade, 100 m from the beach.

2mai-pescari.name: Fishermen's Cottage
2mai-pescari.description: Traditional Dobrujan house with a vine-covered yard.

2mai-boema.name: Bohemian Room 2 Mai
2mai-boema.description: Colourful room with a bohemian vibe, close to the beach in 2 Mai.
